essence: These attendant figures display boon-giving and fearlessness gestures while holding a sword and shield.
Accepted depictions allow either a terrible or very peaceful form, or a form with bound hair.
The arrangement includes Vaktramaṇḍī, Śakārī, and Niśāntā as the ram deity.
Skanda is defined as the peacock-riding army leader who holds a spear.
Every figure in this group bears thunderbolt and lotus and is associated with Skanda's syllables.
